utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the neighborhood repair drive next weekend — I’m a bit behind, but I can help with setup or carrying stuff. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That should work — I’m thinking Saturday morning. We can figure out the exact time once we know who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help with that—what part of the repair drive do you want me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Bo — could you take the tool check and make a simple list of the jobs? Let’s meet Saturday at 10 a.m. to go over it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — that sounds perfect, and I’ll keep your part low-key. I’m glad Sunday at the community center works for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thank you, Rosa — I appreciate you keeping it low-key. I’ll be there Sunday and help out quietly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — could you bring those tools over when you can? I’m keeping a list of the supplies we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll swing by with the tools soon, and just tell me if you need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive coming along?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Pretty well — next weekend we just need help setting up, carrying supplies, and any basic fixing you can do.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right — let’s meet at the community hall first, then we can sort out the repair drive timing after that.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — community hall first, then we’ll set the repair drive timing after that.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help keep an eye on supplies, as long as I can stay in the background a bit. Just let me know what you need tracked.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ve got the locations covered, so if you can quietly track supplies, that’d be a big help. Do you want the drop-off spot or the next place on the list?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Can we lock in the community hall drop-off time first? Once that’s set, I can sort the repair drive timing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — let’s lock in the community hall drop-off time first, and I’ll spread the word right after so folks know when to come.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—want me to spread the word or sort out what we still need?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be great — could you spread the word and I’ll keep pulling together the timing and tool list?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The neighborhood repair drive at the community center lot — I’m still planning to come by around 10 with a drill if I have one.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the community center lot. Thanks, Mara; I’ll keep that in mind and try not to lose it again.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still on for the weekend, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, it’s still on for the weekend. Can you send me the exact drop-off spot so I can keep it straight?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let’s lock in the community hall drop-off time first, and then I can firm up the repair drive timing. What works for you, Hana?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Which repair drive do you mean, and what’s already been checked so far?
